summary: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $50 million at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering via Canaccord Genuity and Roth Capital Partners. The ATM allows continuous sales at market prices (last $3.37/share) with a 3% agent commission. No fixed price, premium, or expected close date. This is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. No special-situation terms such as control, tender, premium, restructuring, activist, or SPAC elements are present. It is a standard financing event.
